static_rejection_review: Missing origin b'' cannot pass _bound_native_layout; it is a missing-value sentinel, not an alternative layout.
Noncanonical bytes, unknown fields, incorrect record/layout digest or encoder reference fail binding validation.
Wrong process ABI fails the prerequisite gate; wrong runtime digest fails binding validation.
An origin not present byte-for-byte in the reviewed read closure is rejected. A stale origin changes binding.identity and cannot reuse old reviewed admission.

The old two-layout search is absent. A 32-bit prefix, nonzero flag/padding/root, odd/short/extended length, terminator, alternate target or extra bytes cannot equal the complete canonical expected buffer.
The unchanged one-shot rename and role change still depend on accepted original native success, not on digest equality alone.
admission_boundary: This is static implementation acceptance, not proof that any current process has the admitted ABI. A real origin must be independently produced and checked for the exact future runtime and encoder sources. Hash equality alone is insufficient. The unchanged execution gate remains false and reviewed bindings remain empty.
residuals: No tests, project functions, original traces, platform operations or matrix cells executed.
No real process/layout origin exists from this work and no live layout/offset/flush guarantee is asserted.
No changes to TSPM-1, PPB-1, public API, snapshot, field path, native encoder, fixture or supervisor.
Future execution requires separately bound source/runtime/origin/parent evidence, limits, external observation, uniqueness and explicit authorization.
